work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Catholic Eastern Churches, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 21 November 1964. Its numbered articles 1-30 address the Churches' dignity, patrimony, governance, sacramental discipline, worship, and relations with separated Eastern Churches.
